subject: Flydubai hijacker planned to crash plane into Ben Gurion Airport, UAE says
posts:
An Omani Flydubai co-pilot plotted a 9/11-style suicide attack on Israel's Ben-Gurion Airport.
Evidence: UAE AG confirmation, cockpit struggle, security failure
#Aletheia #Aviation

Official statements frame the thwarted cockpit hijacking as an isolated incident safely stopped by crew and passengers before reaching its target.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Ground reality reveals a catastrophic vetting failure: an extremist pilot with deep anti-Israel grievances accessed a commercial flight deck to execute a mass-casualty suicide strike.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.85, -0.88) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A commercial pilot's extreme radicalization was missed by aviation security, threatening hundreds of lives.

- Flydubai Vetting: FAIL (-0.80, -0.85) — Failed to screen extremist ideology.
- UAE Authorities: COND (0.0, 0.0) — Disclosed plot after initial suppression.
An Omani co-pilot aboard a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv attempted a 9/11-style suicide attack targeting Ben-Gurion Airport on September 30, thwarted only by crew intervention.

The Poison:
A commercial airline cockpit served as a vector for undetected radicalized violence, exposing profound vulnerabilities in international aviation vetting standards.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The plane error is confusing institutional risk management (WHO is vetted) with reactive heroics (WHAT stopped the plane). The real failure lies in airline screening protocols.

Social Physics Analysis:
Flydubai and security regulators ran a reactive containment loop, downplaying systemic vetting gaps while framing the averted disaster solely as a triumph of onboard passenger bravery.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic security failures are obscured by focusing on the miraculous intervention.

The Unavoidable Truth: Undetected extremist radicalization among commercial flight crew nearly triggered a catastrophic mass casualty attack.

The Unavoidable Lie: Standard aviation security vetting is robust enough to prevent ideological suicide infiltration.

Alethekanon:
Systemic negligence in pilot vetting allowed an extremist to reach the flight deck. Heroic intervention saved lives, but institutional failure enabled the threat.

Awwthekanon:
It is terrifying to think that passengers had to physically fight off a pilot turning a commercial airliner into a weapon of mass destruction.

Brothekanon:
Insane that a pilot managed to smuggle this kind of intent past security screening. Crew and passengers are absolute heroes for stopping it.

"Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, and let not your heart be glad when he stumbles." Proverbs 24:17 PASS
Using geopolitical grievances to justify mass murder in the sky destroys both the innocent and the perpetrator.

Actual Article Body:
The Omani Flydubai co-pilot who hijacked a passenger plane last week planned to crash the aircraft into Ben Gurion International Airport in central Israel, UAE Attorney General Hamad Saif al Shamsi said on Friday.

Hammam al Hammami plotted the 9/11-inspired suicide attack before he was ultimately thwarted by the other pilot and several passengers aboard the commercial flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on Sept. 30. The intended target was the Israeli airport’s passenger terminal, according to the Emirati official.
